<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that breaks the central C=C bond of the target stilbene derivative. The functional group broken in the forward reaction is a C‑C double bond, so we search for templates with that criterion. Then we will apply the found template to the target molecule to obtain the precursor fragments.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
